purpose: Prevent durable evolution-selection verdicts from becoming scope-free while preserving explicit unknown/incomplete qualification and avoiding mandatory Host/model metadata.

SelectionQualification.rule: SCOPED may rely on direct non-empty environment or non-empty represented scope_basis_refs. UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE preserve uncertainty instead of manufacturing scope.

decision_rules.property: UNASSESSED selection needs no scope ceremony
direct represented local scope qualifies a selection without a new mandatory overlay
decision_rules.decision: non-UNASSESSED + non-empty environment + no UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE overlay -> QUALIFIED_DIRECT

decision_rules.property: scope may be represented elsewhere without duplicating it into environment
unknown/incomplete qualification is an honest valid state
a durable verdict with neither scope basis nor explicit uncertainty is unqualified
decision_rules.decision: non-UNASSESSED + empty environment + no valid qualification basis -> UNQUALIFIED_SELECTION

decision_rules.property: negative local selection is not universal prohibition
decision_rules.decision: NOT_SUPPORTED/HARMFUL follows the same qualification rules as SUPPORTED/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN

decision_rules.property: source selection and receiver/local selection remain separate
decision_rules.decision: migration source selection is evaluated against source_environment/source_selection_qualification independently from local selection

decision_rules.property: represented qualification is not external completeness proof
decision_rules.decision: QUALIFIED_* establishes represented scope basis only; no external materiality/completeness/authenticity claim

interpretation.QUALIFIED_DIRECT: Verdict has a represented direct scope basis in environment.
interpretation.QUALIFIED_REFERENCED: Verdict names represented references where its material scope basis is carried.
interpretation.QUALIFICATION_UNKNOWN: Verdict occurrence may be retained, but its material selection scope is explicitly unknown/incomplete; portability/applicability claims must remain narrowed.
interpretation.UNQUALIFIED_SELECTION: Verdict is represented without a reconstructable/direct scope basis and without explicit uncertainty; do not narrate it as scope-qualified.
interpretation.NOT_APPLICABLE: No selection verdict requiring qualification is asserted.

verification_boundary: represented selection qualification only; no external scope completeness, selection truth, evidence authenticity, or receiver-local selection proof
